import numpy as np
import sys

# Test the np.dot behavior with inf - inf scenario
try:
    # Set up the test inputs
    a = np.array([1, 1], dtype=np.double)
    b = np.array([-np.inf, np.inf], dtype=np.double)
    
    # Try to call np.dot with errstate set to raise on invalid
    with np.errstate(invalid='raise'):
        result = np.dot(a, b)
    
    # If we get here, no exception was raised - record the result
    probe("np.dot(np.array([1, 1], dtype=np.double), np.array([-np.inf, np.inf], dtype=np.double))", result)
    probe("np.dot(np.array([1, 1], dtype=np.double), np.array([-np.inf, np.inf], dtype=np.double))::result_type", type(result).__name__)
    
except FloatingPointError as e:
    # Exception was raised - record it
    probe("np.dot(np.array([1, 1], dtype=np.double), np.array([-np.inf, np.inf], dtype=np.double))", "__error__: FloatingPointError: " + str(e))
except Exception as e:
    # Some other exception
    probe("np.dot(np.array([1, 1], dtype=np.double), np.array([-np.inf, np.inf], dtype=np.double))", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))
